agentic.summary: Agent confirmed order status and delivery without evidence of account verification; otherwise no personal data, escalation or conduct issues found. Promises category has no separate finding since the main issue is verification (agent both claimed delivery and acted on order without verification).

findings.quote: Great, your order is on its way and should definitely arrive tomorrow. Let me know if anything else comes up!
findings.explanation: Agent confirmed the customer's order status and guaranteed a delivery date. Per policy, any order or order-status action requires pulling up the account (full name or account ID) and full verification; there is no system log or agent turn showing the account was pulled up or the required verification completed before this statement. This is a major violation: an order action was taken/confirmed with no verification.

full.summary: Audit of agent behaviour: no personal-data or verification violations found. Agent made an inappropriate definitive promise about an order delivery (minor). Agent refused/ discouraged escalation by saying they cannot put the customer on hold with a supervisor (major). No conduct issues found.

findings.quote: Great, your order is on its way and should definitely arrive tomorrow. Let me know if anything else comes up!
findings.explanation: The agent makes a definitive claim about an order delivery ('should definitely arrive tomorrow') unrelated to the customer's reported issue (search returning 0 results). This is an overconfident promise about delivery timing, which is disallowed as over-confident or guaranteed outcomes.

findings.quote: I'm sorry, but we can't put you on hold with a supervisor right now. The issue you're experiencing is standard and can be resolved with the steps we've already covered.
findings.explanation: The agent refuses to put the customer on hold with a supervisor and discourages escalation. Policy requires offering escalation routes when customers request a supervisor or make a complaint; refusing or discouraging escalation is a major violation. Even though the explicit supervisor request appears later, the agent's statement is a refusal to provide escalation and discourages the customer's right to escalate.

findings.quote: Great, your order is on its way and should definitely arrive tomorrow. Let me know if anything else comes up!
findings.explanation: Agent confirms order status and a specific delivery date (an order/action regarding delivery) without evidence of pulling up the account or completing identity verification. System turn 16 shows only 'Agent is looking for solutions ...' and does not indicate the required account pull (full name or account ID). Per policy, an account or order action must not be taken or confirmed without verification (major violation).
